data.title: About Meredith
bio: After purchasing her first home in 2012, Meredith Battito gained firsthand insight into the real estate process, an experience that sparked her passion for helping others navigate one of life’s most important investments.  Motivated to make the journey smoother and more rewarding for others, she earned her real estate license and has been dedicated to serving clients ever since.  A lifelong resident of New Jersey, Meredith has extensive knowledge of the Central Jersey market and a deep understanding of the communities she serves.

She has successfully assisted families and friends in buying and selling homes, consistently working to secure the best possible outcomes for her clients.  Known for her reliability, attention to detail, and commitment to client satisfaction, Meredith guides her clients through every step of the process, from initial consultation to closing, ensuring a seamless and stress-free experience.  Whether you're buying your first home, selling your current property, or exploring your options, Meredith is ready to help.
Reach out today to discuss your real estate needs.
